writtenBy: OWNER-TYPED CLIP LINES ONLY. The hub appends a record here, in its own reviewed commit, when the owner types a CLIP line for a venue; agents and producer lanes never write this file. The runner reads it ONLY as committed at HEAD (git show HEAD:<this path>) and refuses when the working copy differs, so an uncommitted or caller-supplied file is never consent. A record is keyed by venue + clip id and carries the owner's exact typed line (it contains no path), the line's sha256, when it was recorded and 'owner' as recordedBy. No path, no footage file name, ever. One alias: the line's venue is the record's venue (the venue table's name) or that same name with every hyphen removed ("CLIP ultramagnus: M16-1243" for ultra-magnus), case-sensitive and exact; the record's venue field stays the table name and ownerLine is stored verbatim.

recordShape.ownerLine: CLIP <venue>: <clipId>  (e.g. CLIP bachelor: M16-1243; <venue> may also be the table name with its hyphens removed; the owner's exact words, no path)
recordShape.ownerLineSha256: <sha256 (64 lowercase hex) of ownerLine as UTF-8>
